newsitem.title: USA: CBOE, PSE to list new options next week.
newsitem.headline: CBOE, PSE to list new options next week.

text.p: Chicago Board Options Exchange and Pacific Stock Exchange said Friday they will list new equity options next week.
CBOE will list options on Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp on Dec 4 and the PSE said it will list options on Enserch Exploration Inc on Dec 2.
Ultramar Diamond Shamrock options will have introductory expirations in December, January, April and July, with opening strike prices of 25, 30 and 35.
They will trade in the Merck & Co trading crowd.
Diamond Shamrock Inc plans to close its merger with Ultramar Corp on Dec 3.
For Ensearch, options will have initial expirations in December, January, April and July. Opening strikes will be 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2.
The options will trade in the Advanced Micro Devices Inc trading crowd.
